# Thatch & Trail

> A free, independent guide to visiting vineyards in England, Wales and the Channel Islands: 145 vineyards and wineries open to visitors, 122 of them estate-verified. Each listing covers opening days, tours and tastings, food, places to stay, dogs and children, and how to get there without a car.

"Estate-verified" means the estate itself confirmed the details to Thatch & Trail by email; the month of confirmation is shown on each page. Details not confirmed by the estate are labelled "From their website". Thatch & Trail does not accept payment for listings or reviews. Last updated November 2026.

## Find vineyards
- [All vineyards and the UK map](https://thatchandtrail.com/): every estate, filterable by region, food, stay and verified status
- [Regions](https://thatchandtrail.com/regions/): one page per region
- [Vineyards near you](https://thatchandtrail.com/near/): vineyards near major towns, nearest first, with distances
- [What estate-verified means](https://thatchandtrail.com/verified)
